4. Anatomy of the 19.3 Manual Hours Per Texas Mineral Assignment

Conservative task-level minute assumptions derived from experienced Texas landman workflows and the reproducible 10-assignment pipeline test harness.

Task Component Manual Unit Time Representative 45-Deed Chain Automation Mechanism in #1 Tied Leaders
Abstract one recorded instrument onto a runsheet row (parties, dates, Vol/Page, granting/reservation clauses) 12 min 540 min Automated with page-image citation & human review gate
Transcribe one runsheet row cleanly into the client's Excel workbook format 3 min 135 min Generated directly into 4-sheet .xlsx or custom client template
Work one fractional conveyance, reservation, or heirship split through the ownership ledger by hand 8 min 256 min Deterministic BigInt / 3-model verified rational fraction ledger
Verify each tract balances to 100.000000% (exact 1/1) and hunt down rounding or Duhig discrepancies 15 min 45 min Instant exact-fraction balance proof + Duhig / shortfall flag
Draft one curative requirement / title defect note with recording citations 20 min 80 min Pre-drafted in Title Review sheet / Issues register with Vol/Page links
Assemble numbered deliverable folder tree and rename/file source instrument PDFs 55 min 55 min Automated in TitleDesk Desktop Agent custom folder-tree builder
Re-format a completed MOR / DDR report to satisfy a second operator's column layout 45 min 45 min Zero-code template switch in TitleDesk Desktop Agent
Total Mechanical Production Work — 1,156 min (19.3 hrs) Compressed to ~2.2 – 2.8 hrs of high-value human CPL review & curative judgment
